chunks.text: Ticket ID: TKT-001 Status: Resolved Category: Authentication Customer Issue: The application keeps logging me out every few minutes. I have to enter my username and password repeatedly. Support: We found that the authentication session token was expiring prematurely. Resolution: The authentication token configuration was corrected and the user's session was refreshed. The customer confirmed the issue was resolved.

Ticket ID: TKT-002 Status: Resolved Category: Payments Customer Issue: I was charged twice for the same order. Both transactions have the same amount. Support: We checked the payment gateway and confirmed that the transaction was submitted twice. Resolution: The duplicate payment was reversed and the customer was refunded.

Ticket ID: TKT-003 Status: Resolved Category: Password Customer Issue: I cannot remember my password and I am unable to access my account. Support: We verified the customer's identity and initiated a password reset. Resolution: A password reset link was sent to the registered email address. The customer successfully logged in.

Ticket ID: TKT-004 Status: Resolved Category: Mobile Application Customer Issue: The mobile application closes unexpectedly whenever I open the reports section. Support: We found a known issue in the reporting module of the installed app version. Resolution: The customer updated the application to the latest version. The reports section then worked normally.

Ticket ID: TKT-005 Status: Resolved Category: Account Balance Customer Issue: My account balance has not changed even though I transferred money into the account this morning. Support: The incoming transfer was still being processed. Resolution: The transfer was manually reconciled and the account balance was updated.

Ticket ID: TKT-006 Status: Resolved Category: Notifications Customer Issue: I am no longer receiving email notifications when transactions happen on my account. Support: Transaction alerts had been disabled in the notification settings. Resolution: Transaction email notifications were enabled again and a test notification was delivered successfully.

Ticket ID: TKT-007 Status: Resolved Category: Performance Customer Issue: The dashboard takes a very long time to load and sometimes appears frozen. Support: We identified a database query that was taking longer than expected. Resolution: The database query was optimized and the application cache was refreshed. Dashboard loading returned to normal.

Ticket ID: TKT-008 Status: Resolved Category: Credit Card Customer Issue: My credit card payment was declined even though I have sufficient funds available. Support: The card security system had temporarily blocked the card because of an unusual transaction pattern. Resolution: The security block was removed after verifying the customer's identity. The customer successfully completed a transaction.

Ticket ID: TKT-009 Status: Resolved Category: File Upload Customer Issue: I am trying to upload a PDF document but the system keeps rejecting the file. Support: The document contained an unsupported PDF encoding. Resolution: The customer saved the document again using a standard PDF format. The new file uploaded successfully.

Ticket ID: TKT-010 Status: Resolved Category: Transaction Customer Issue: A transaction that I made yesterday is still showing as pending. Support: The payment was waiting for final settlement from the payment processor. Resolution: The transaction completed successfully after settlement and changed from pending to completed.
